name: ClearTwoWords

name: ResetCounter

name: ReleaseCounterRef

name: MaskWorldBitsBySave
evidence: returns g_saveData's word 0x19F0 masked by the current world's bits (seventeen functions test it)

name: CollectEntriesForKey
evidence: runs a query over src's data and gathers up to maxOut distinct entries whose k0 or k1 equals key into out, returning the count

name: InitGifPacket

name: EndGifPacket
evidence: opens a final tag (func_001613C0) when none is open, then calls the table's close entry with flag 1

name: CloseGifTag
evidence: slot 3 of D_0024A6F8: pads the cursor to 16 bytes and ORs the entry count (f24 / f20) and, when n is set, bit 15 into the open tag's first word

name: CountGifEntry
evidence: increments the entry counter at +0x24 of the packet and returns it; every Add* writer below calls it first

name: ReserveGifPackedData
evidence: closes any open tag, writes a tag with nloop, nreg and prim, stores the pointer past it in *out and advances the cursor over nloop * nreg quadwords

name: BeginGifTag
evidence: closes any open tag then writes a new one: prim a1 at bit 47, register count a2 at bit 60, register list a3, remembering it as the open tag

name: AddGifRgbaEntry
evidence: adds a packed entry whose four words are the four bytes of value (register 1, RGBAQ)

name: AddGifUvEntry
evidence: adds a packed entry of two integers (register 3, UV)

name: AddGifStEntry
evidence: adds a packed entry of three floats (register 2, ST with Q)

name: AddGifXyzEntry
evidence: adds a packed entry of two integers and a 64-bit value (register 5, XYZ2)

name: AddGifXyzfEntry
evidence: adds a packed entry of three words and a fourth word a4 << 4 (register 4, XYZF2)

name: AddGifXyzfNoDrawEntry
evidence: like AddGifXyzfEntry but masks the third word to 24 bits and sets bit 15 of the fourth (the drawing-kick-off disable bit)

name: AddGifRegisterWrite
evidence: adds an address-and-data entry (register 14, A+D): the value a2 first, the register address a1 second

name: BeginGifRegListTag
evidence: closes any open tag and writes a tag in register-list mode (bit 58) with register count a1, remembering it as the open tag

name: AddGifRegListFloat
evidence: adds one 64-bit register-list entry: tag in the low word, the float's bits in the high word

name: AddGifUvRegListEntry
evidence: counts a register-list entry and writes the 64-bit UV word (u and v << 16) at the writer's cursor (the font's glyph drawing calls it)

name: AddGifXyzfRegListEntry
evidence: counts a register-list entry and writes the 64-bit XYZF word (x, y << 16, z in bits 32 to 55, fog in the top byte) at the writer's cursor

name: AddGifImageTag
evidence: writes a 16-byte tag with the quadword count in the low bits and mode 2 (image) at bit 58

name: InitVertexBatch

evidence: for a vertex batch whose description (+0xF8) asks for lights, finds up to 16 of them around its bounds with CollectLightsForSphere into +0xB0..+0xB8 and sets the mode +0x94 to 4, else clears them and sets it to -1

name: ResetVertexBatch
evidence: clears the shape word at +0xF8 and vertex count at +0x124 and zeroes the 0x1720-byte vertex list at +0x128

name: BuildLitVertexPacket
evidence: like the unlit builder but also writes each vertex's three normal components in groups of four, for shape 0

name: SetVertexPosition
evidence: copies a three-float vector into the current vertex's x, y and z at 0xFC

name: SetVertexColor
evidence: stores a 32-bit colour into the current vertex at 0x114 (func_00161BB0 and func_001C30E8 pass 0xFFFFFFFF or a colour whose alpha they set)

name: AddVertex

name: CollectNonNullRefs

name: BuildLitStripMeshPacket
